shallow_engine_graph_tensor_storage.scope: Unique backing storage for tensors directly owned by the engine, its canonical graph, and graph wrapper at construction time. Excludes checkpoint staging, tensors nested in containers/model objects, compiler workspaces, allocator reservation, and caches.

workload.checkpoint_replica_semantics: one deterministic shared int32 state[N] and fp32 age[N] pair is broadcast by EnsembleEngine.set_initial_state into [N, R]
workload.graph_semantics: seeded exact-simple undirected degree-regular circulant built directly in int32 CSR; not a uniform random-regular sample

warmup_policy.phase_order: finish priming calls, then start a fresh duration clock
warmup_policy.synchronization: before priming and after every target call
